approved_scope.title: Closed pipe and help
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: Bug fixes that bring Chough to what its requirements already assume: no requirement says a command panics or exits 101 when its reader goes away, or that help depends on where it stands among the global options; docs/cli.md's sentence on -V is corrected to match the helper.
acceptance_criteria: Every command whose standard output or standard error is closed, as in chough next | true or chough next | head -1, stops printing and exits with the code it would have exited with, never 101 and never a panic or a Broken pipe message; a write command still saves (#383). chough --root . help --help, chough --root=. help -h and chough --redact help --help print the top-level help and exit 0, as chough help --help does, and docs/cli.md names --help and -h as the help flags and chough -V and --version as the top-level version flags (#399).

answers.constraints: The issues set the scope: #383's closed-pipe half (s7-F5; the Unicode half moved to #410 in 0.6.3) and #399 (review of #309, Leif: fix in 0.6.2). Leif asked to check which commands still panic before fixing: measured on main 7bf110dc, every command that prints panics with 101 into a closed pipe, except clap's own help; change ready and the ship summary exit 1 with Error: Broken pipe. Recommended choices only. No new refusal and no requirement wording changes (no-spec, as #309 was). No new dependency. Failing tests first.
